title: Accelerator Choice Is Not Enough: AlphaFold2 Inference on Cloud TPUs
abstract: arXiv:2609.34818v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AlphaFold2 is written in JAX, so the same inference code compiles and runs unchanged on CPUs, GPUs and Google Cloud TPUs. That portability makes the accelerator look like the main decision a user has to make. We show that it is not. Running one AlphaFold2 inference workload across a Colab CPU runtime, an NVIDIA T4 GPU and a dedicated eight-chip Cloud TPU v5e slice, we find a large hardware advantage for the TPU, 0.47 s per call in steady state on a single chip against 13.1 s on the T4 in the same measurement campaign, and three ways in which the software layer decides how much of it a user actually gets. The default execution path uses one chip of the eight, and at list prices the idle capacity makes the slice cost about as much per prediction as the GPU. Batching with JAX's vmap never exceeds single-query throughput, while mapping queries across chips with JAX's pmap gives eight chips 6.5-7.9x the throughput of one on a matche

translated_title: 加速器选择还不够：在云端TPU上进行AlphaFold2推理
translated_abstract: AlphaFold2是用JAX编写的，因此相同的推理代码无需修改即可在CPU、GPU和Google Cloud TPU上编译并运行。这种可移植性使得加速器的选择看起来像是用户需要做出的主要决策。我们证明事实并非如此。我们在Colab CPU运行时、NVIDIA T4 GPU以及专用的八芯片Cloud TPU v5e切片上运行同一AlphaFold2推理工作负载，发现TPU具有巨大的硬件优势——在同一测量活动中，单芯片稳态下每次调用仅需0.47秒，而T4需要13.1秒——但同时发现软件层在三个方面决定了用户实际能获得多少这一优势。默认执行路径仅使用八颗芯片中的一颗，按标价计算，闲置容量使得该切片每次预测的成本与GPU大致相当。使用JAX的vmap进行批处理始终无法超过单查询吞吐量，而使用JAX的pmap将查询映射到多颗芯片上，可使八颗芯片在匹配条件下获得单芯片6.5-7.9倍的吞吐量。
tldr: 仅选择TPU等加速器并不足够，软件层的配置（如使用JAX的pmap将查询映射到多颗芯片）才能真正释放AlphaFold2在云端TPU上的硬件性能优势。
en_tdlr: Accelerator choice alone is not enough—software-layer decisions, such as using JAX's pmap to map queries across chips, determine whether users actually realize the full hardware advantage of Cloud TPUs for AlphaFold2 inference.
